description_en: Creates a custom stream mixing template
kebab_example: aliyun live create-custom-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --custom-template height_:_1060_,_scale_:_16:9_,_gop_:_60_,_bframes_:_30_,_cdesc_:_h264 --template TestTemplate --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The custom template in JSON format: {height:xxx,scale:xxx,gop:xxx,bframes:xxx,cdesc:xxx}. All fields are required. If any field is missing, the call fails.

For more information about the parameters, see the CustomTemplate description table below
parameters.help_zh:
JSON格式{height:xxx,scale:xxx,gop:xxx,bframes:xxx,cdesc:xxx}，所有字段均必填，缺少其中任意字段会调用失败。

具体参数请参考下表CustomTemplate说明
parameters.name: custom_template

parameters.help_en:
The name of the template to add.
Record the template name when you create the template. The template name is required for using, querying, and deleting the template
parameters.help_zh:
需要添加的模板名。
请在创建时记录模板名，用于使用、查询和删除操作
parameters.name: template
